Announcement.title: Announcement
Announcement.description: Broadcast notifications and messages sent by the admin to all app users for specific occasions or updates.

title.description: Title of the notification or occasion message

message.description: Body content of the broadcast notification

occasion.description: Occasion category (e.g. eid, ramadan, jummah, general, update)

priority.description: Priority level of the broadcast notification

readAt.description: Timestamp when the announcement was first read/viewed by user, triggering 24h auto-deletion

targetTab.description: Optional in-app tab link when tapped

isActive.description: Whether the announcement is active and visible

UserMessage.title: UserMessage
UserMessage.description: Direct message, prayer request, feedback or notification sent from a user to the admin.

senderName.description: Name of the user sending the message

senderEmail.description: Email address of the user for replies

category.description: Category or topic of the message

subject.description: Subject or summary of the message

message.description: Detailed body message from the user

readAt.description: Timestamp when the message was read by the admin, triggering 24h auto-deletion

/announcements/{announcementId}.description: Public broadcast announcements and notifications readable by all users.

/user_messages/{messageId}.description: Messages, feedbacks, and questions sent by users to the app admin.
